name: Ruin'yuiki
source:
One of the ancient nature spirits who serves the pantheon of Elven gods. He holds sway over lesser elemental water spirits.

[Spoiler] He initially sees Fia as an enemy and must be subdued before he is brought back to his senses. The most loyal of Fia's summoned spirits but stubborn and distrustful of Avaro's intentions. [/Spoiler]
